pack.title: Unsolicited life advice
pack.description: Love, expressed as instructions. Receive the love, decline the orders.

scenarios.setting: Phone call. Your parent, ten minutes into your career choices.
scenarios.jab: I'm just saying — at your age I already owned a house.

replies.line: Different market, same work ethic. I'm on my path.
replies.why: It names the real difference once, then closes with a fact that needs no defense.
It receives the message without receiving the assignment.

replies.line: I know — you set the bar high. I'm getting there my way.
replies.why: Crediting them first makes your different path sound like inheritance, not rebellion.

replies.line: And uphill both ways, I know. Legend behavior.
replies.why: Joining the mythology with affection steers the call back to fondness.

trap.line: Yeah well houses cost triple now, so thanks for nothing.
trap.why: Winning the economics debate loses the phone call with your parent.

scenarios.setting: Family group chat. Your sibling, replying to your weekend plans.
scenarios.jab: Must be nice to have no responsibilities lol

replies.line: It is. You should try a weekend off too.
replies.why: Agreeing plus prescribing rest reframes the dig as a wellness tip.

replies.line: Haha — join me next time and we'll both be irresponsible.
replies.why: An invitation converts the envy underneath into plans.

replies.line: My responsibilities filed for the weekend. Union rules.
replies.why: Absurd paperwork makes the whole thread laugh past the jab.
